property_summary: For any caller, when calling fallback with exactly 10 ether and a strictly increasing timestamp, the reference contract C always increases its stored pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp (so address(c).balance may grow and pastBlockTime == block.timestamp), but the mutant that refunds msg.value before updating pastBlockTime can leave pastBlockTime unchanged relative to block.timestamp (or leave contract balance unchanged) for some inputs — specifically when the immediate refund prevents the contract from accumulating balance used in the conditional payout path.
change_summary: Insert an immediate refund of msg.value before updating pastBlockTime so caller gets refunded and contract balance doesn't grow.
